messages:
carla: quick alert — prod proxy pool in apac showing connection resets after last config push. I have hotfix that reverts keepalive to previous value. Request expedited staging->prod with ops + eng signoff to skip canary. /cc @ops-rahul @sre-kim
deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: release/proxy-keepalive-revert@v2.0.5 -> staging. Required approvals: [ops, eng]. Approve: `approve deploy 6135792468` or https://deploy.local/6135792468

ops-rahul: Blast radius? rollback steps?

carla: Blast radius: apac edge pools only (~9% traffic). Rollback: revert to proxy@v2.0.4 if 5xx > 0.6% for 5m or p95 latency +200ms. Rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback release/proxy@v2.0.4 --env=staging`. Logs: https://logs.local/proxy/apac/6135792468

sre-kim: Approving expedited staging deploy. Will watch traces. :thumbsup:

eng-lead-iva: Eng approves with smoke checklist: 1) synthetic connect test 2) 1m health 3) spot-check flows. Need 10m quiet before prod.

carla: Triggering staging: `/deploy release/proxy-keepalive-revert@v2.0.5 --env=staging --skip-canary --tag=hotfix-6135792468`

deploy-bot: Deploy started -> staging. Logs: https://deploy.local/6135792468/logs

carla: Staging smoke PASS. Synthetic connect and health ok. 11m quiet. Requesting prod promote.

ops-rahul: Ops approves prod progression. I want 2% slice for 10m then ramp to 100% if stable.

carla: Initiating prod rollout: `/deploy release/proxy-keepalive-revert@v2.0.5 --env=prod --traffic-split=2,25,100 --gates=10m`

deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback thresholds applied.

sre-kim: 2% slice stable. Advancing.

eng-lead-iva: 100% reached, monitoring for 30m then close incident. Good job.

pm-jo: PM note: release note drafted and linked to ticket RED-5100.
